title: companion-cli description file
description: A file that `companion-cli apply` writes into Companion 5.1's database. `kind` selects what it describes. Only `$(custom:…)` references are checked against the database.

oneOf.title: kind: variables
oneOf.description: Creates or replaces custom variables. Variables the file does not name are untouched.

variables.description: The custom variables to create or replace. At least one; names must be distinct.
variables.$comment: Not expressible here: names must be distinct.

oneOf.title: kind: button
oneOf.description: Replaces the button at one location of an existing page with a `button-layered` control.

steps.$comment: With `steps`, the top-level action lists are refused.

text.description: The button text; may be empty.

textColor.description: The text color. Without it, black on a bright background and white otherwise.

progression.description: How the button moves between steps: `auto` advances on each press, `manual` only through actions, `expression` follows `stepExpression`.

stepExpression.description: A Companion expression giving the step to show. Required with `progression: expression`, refused otherwise.

notes.description: Notes on the button, shown in Companion's editor.

apiStyle.description: Let Companion's HTTP and other APIs change the button's style (`canModifyStyleInApis`). Companion's default, false, refuses that.

down.description: Actions run when the button is pressed. Cannot be combined with steps.

up.description: Actions run when the button is released. Cannot be combined with steps.

rotate_left.description: Actions run when an encoder turns left. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions. Cannot be combined with steps.

rotate_right.description: Actions run when an encoder turns right. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions. Cannot be combined with steps.

hold.description: Hold action sets: actions run once the button has been held a number of milliseconds. Each duration at most once per step. Cannot be combined with steps.
hold.$comment: Not expressible here: durations must be distinct.

steps.description: The button's steps, replacing the top-level action lists: at least one, each with its own action lists. Cannot be combined with down, up, rotate_left, rotate_right or hold.

feedbacks.description: Boolean feedbacks that override the button's style while they hold.

oneOf.title: kind: page
oneOf.description: Replaces one page's name and all of its buttons, creating the page when it does not exist. Every button the page held is deleted, navigation buttons included.

page.description: The page number, at least 1. A page beyond the last page plus one also creates the empty pages in between.

buttons.description: Every button on the page; an empty list clears it. Each location must be distinct.
buttons.$comment: Not expressible here: locations must be distinct.

oneOf.title: kind: trigger
oneOf.description: Creates or replaces one trigger, identified by its name. Its condition is always empty and its notes are reset.

name.description: The trigger's name, which identifies it: a trigger with this name is replaced under its id, keeping its order and collection; otherwise one is created.

events.description: What starts the trigger. At least one.

actions.description: The actions the trigger runs, in order.

oneOf.title: kind: triggers
oneOf.description: Creates or replaces several triggers in one apply, each exactly as a `kind: trigger` file would. Triggers the file does not name are untouched.

triggers.description: The triggers to create or replace, in order. At least one; names must be distinct.
triggers.$comment: Not expressible here: names must be distinct.

oneOf.title: kind: connection
oneOf.description: Edits one existing connection: its label, enabled flag, config and secrets (from the environment). Config and secrets merge into what is stored; nothing else changes.
oneOf.$comment: Set at least one of label, enabled, config or secrets. With kind and connection required and no other properties allowed, that is three properties.

connection.description: The connection to edit: its label, or `id:<id>` when several share a label.

label.description: A new label: letters, digits, _ and -, and not a name Companion reserves (internal, this, local, companion, image, custom, expression, page; in any case). A rename is refused while buttons or triggers reference the old label.

config.description: Config keys to set, merged into the stored config; other keys are kept. Checked against the module's config fields when Companion is running; otherwise each key must already be stored with the same type (or pass --unchecked).

secrets.description: Secret keys to set, merged into the stored secrets, each from an environment variable. Never a literal value.

additionalProperties.description: The environment variable holding the secret's value.

oneOf.title: kind: surface
oneOf.description: Changes one stored surface's name, enabled flag and config keys. Named config keys are merged; every other key, the surface's group settings and the other surfaces are untouched.

surface.description: The stored surface id, exactly (`companion-cli list surfaces`). The surface must exist; surfaces are never created.

transferInputs.description: Transfer-variable inputs: `<id>: <custom variable>` sets `config.transfer_input_<id>`, the custom variable that receives the surface's value ("" for none). The variable must exist.

transferOutputs.description: Transfer-variable outputs: `<id>: <expression>` sets `config.transfer_output_<id>`, the expression whose value is sent to the surface. Its `$(custom:…)` references are checked.

config.description: Any other config key, set as given. A key with a named field (brightness, rotation, xOffset, yOffset, transfer_input_*, transfer_output_*, plugin_cfg_*) or `groupId` is refused.

variableName.description: A custom variable name: letters A-Z/a-z, digits and _ (Companion's rule for `$(custom:<name>)`), not a name Companion reserves, and not one that looks like a number.

color.description: A color "#RRGGBB". Quote it in YAML: an unquoted # starts a comment.

text.description: Button text. Line breaks are kept, except that one trailing line break (a `|` block's) is dropped. `$(custom:…)` references in it are checked against the database; other variables are not.

jsonValue.description: Any JSON value: null, a boolean, a finite number, a string, or a list or mapping of JSON values.

default.description: The default value. With `persist: true` on a variable already persisted, the stored current value is kept instead.

persist.description: Whether Companion keeps the current value across restarts.

location.description: A button's page, row and column.

page.description: The page number, at least 1. The page must exist; only a page file creates pages.

row.description: The row; may be negative. Checked against the grid size in the database.

column.description: The column; may be negative. Checked against the grid size in the database.

cell.description: A button's row and column on the page.

row.description: The row; may be negative. Checked against the grid size in the database.

column.description: The column; may be negative. Checked against the grid size in the database.

pageButton.description: A button on the page: every `kind: button` field, with a location of row and column only.

steps.$comment: With `steps`, the top-level action lists are refused.

location.description: Where the button goes on the page.

text.description: The button text; may be empty.

textColor.description: The text color. Without it, black on a bright background and white otherwise.

progression.description: How the button moves between steps: `auto` advances on each press, `manual` only through actions, `expression` follows `stepExpression`.

stepExpression.description: A Companion expression giving the step to show. Required with `progression: expression`, refused otherwise.

notes.description: Notes on the button, shown in Companion's editor.

apiStyle.description: Let Companion's HTTP and other APIs change the button's style (`canModifyStyleInApis`). Companion's default, false, refuses that.

down.description: Actions run when the button is pressed. Cannot be combined with steps.

up.description: Actions run when the button is released. Cannot be combined with steps.

rotate_left.description: Actions run when an encoder turns left. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions. Cannot be combined with steps.

rotate_right.description: Actions run when an encoder turns right. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions. Cannot be combined with steps.

hold.description: Hold action sets: actions run once the button has been held a number of milliseconds. Each duration at most once per step. Cannot be combined with steps.
hold.$comment: Not expressible here: durations must be distinct.

steps.description: The button's steps, replacing the top-level action lists: at least one, each with its own action lists. Cannot be combined with down, up, rotate_left, rotate_right or hold.

feedbacks.description: Boolean feedbacks that override the button's style while they hold.

step.description: One step of a button: its own action lists.

down.description: Actions run when the button is pressed.

up.description: Actions run when the button is released.

rotate_left.description: Actions run when an encoder turns left. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions.

rotate_right.description: Actions run when an encoder turns right. Any rotate key, even an empty list, turns on the button's rotary actions.

hold.description: Hold action sets: actions run once the button has been held a number of milliseconds. Each duration at most once per step.
hold.$comment: Not expressible here: durations must be distinct.

hold.description: A hold action set: actions run once the button has been held `after` milliseconds.

after.description: How long the button must be held, in milliseconds; a positive integer, unique within the step.

whileHeld.description: Run the actions while the button is still held. Without it, they run on release, if the button was held at least this long.

action.description: An action, tagged with `action`. Only `$(custom:…)` references and named variables are checked against the database; pass-through actions are written literally and not checked.

oneOf.title: action: set
oneOf.description: Sets a custom variable to a fixed value. Written as Companion's internal `custom_variable_set_value` action (connection `internal`).

variable.description: The custom variable to set, by name (without `custom:`). It must exist in the database.

value.description: The value, stored as text (numbers and booleans become strings). `$(custom:…)` references in it are checked against the database.

oneOf.title: action: expression
oneOf.description: Sets a custom variable to the result of a Companion expression. Written as Companion's internal `custom_variable_set_value` action (connection `internal`).

variable.description: The custom variable to set, by name (without `custom:`). It must exist in the database.

expression.description: A Companion expression, for example `$(custom:fx_counter) * 2`. `$(custom:…)` references in it are checked against the database.

oneOf.title: action: increment
oneOf.description: Adds to a custom variable (the expression `$(this:current) + by`). Written as Companion's internal `custom_variable_set_value` action (connection `internal`).

variable.description: The custom variable to set, by name (without `custom:`). It must exist in the database.

oneOf.title: action: decrement
oneOf.description: Subtracts from a custom variable (the expression `$(this:current) - by`). Written as Companion's internal `custom_variable_set_value` action (connection `internal`).

variable.description: The custom variable to set, by name (without `custom:`). It must exist in the database.

oneOf.title: action: passthrough
oneOf.description: Any connection's action, written literally: connection, definition and options are not checked against the database.

connection.description: The connection id, written literally and not checked against the database.

definition.description: The connection's definition id, written literally and not checked against the database.

options.description: The definition's options, each stored as a plain (non-expression) value; not checked.

feedback.description: A boolean feedback, tagged with `feedback`, that overrides the button's style while it holds.

oneOf.title: feedback: step
oneOf.description: Holds while the button is on the given step. Written as Companion's internal `bank_current_step` feedback, with `$(this:location)` as the button.

step.description: The step, 1-based. It must not exceed the button's number of steps.
step.$comment: Not expressible here: the step must be at most the number of the button's steps (1 without `steps`).

style.description: The style fields to override while the feedback holds.

invert.description: Holds while the condition is false instead.

oneOf.title: feedback: expression
oneOf.description: Holds while a Companion boolean expression is true. Written as Companion's internal `check_expression` feedback.

expression.description: A Companion expression, for example `$(custom:fx_label) == 'on'`. `$(custom:…)` references in it are checked against the database.

style.description: The style fields to override while the feedback holds.

invert.description: Holds while the condition is false instead.

oneOf.title: feedback: passthrough
oneOf.description: Any connection's boolean feedback, written literally: connection, definition and options are not checked against the database.

connection.description: The connection id, written literally and not checked against the database.

definition.description: The connection's definition id, written literally and not checked against the database.

options.description: The definition's options, each stored as a plain (non-expression) value; not checked.

style.description: The style fields to override while the feedback holds.

invert.description: Holds while the condition is false instead.

style.description: The style fields a feedback overrides; at least one. The others keep the button's own style.

triggerBody.description: One trigger: every `kind: trigger` field, without `kind`.

name.description: The trigger's name, which identifies it: a trigger with this name is replaced under its id, keeping its order and collection; otherwise one is created.

events.description: What starts the trigger. At least one.

actions.description: The actions the trigger runs, in order.

event.description: What starts a trigger, tagged with `event`.

oneOf.title: event: startup
oneOf.description: Runs when Companion starts.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: interval
oneOf.description: Runs every so many seconds.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: intervalRandom
oneOf.description: Runs again and again, each time after a random whole number of seconds from `min` to `max`.

max.description: The longest interval in seconds; at least `min`.
max.$comment: Not expressible here: max must be at least min.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: timeofday
oneOf.description: Runs at a time of day on the given days, in Companion's configured timezone (or the system's).

days.description: The days it runs on, at least one.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: specificDate
oneOf.description: Runs once, at a date and time in Companion's configured timezone (or the system's).

date.$comment: Not expressible here: the date must exist in the calendar.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: sun_event
oneOf.description: Runs at sunrise or sunset at a place, shifted by an offset.

offset.description: Minutes after (or, when negative, before) the event.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: client_connect
oneOf.description: Runs when a web client connects to Companion.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after the connection.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: button_press
oneOf.description: Runs when any button is pressed.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: button_release
oneOf.description: Runs when any button is released.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: variable_changed
oneOf.description: Runs when a variable's value changes: a custom variable by `variable`, or any other by `variableId`.
oneOf.$comment: Not expressible here: one of variable and variableId is required, and a variableId must not start with custom: (use variable).

variable.description: The custom variable, by name (without `custom:`). It must exist in the database. Give this or `variableId`.

variableId.description: Any other variable, as `<label>:<name>` (for example `internal:time_hms` or `local:counter`), stored as given and not checked against the database. Give this or `variable`.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: computer_locked
oneOf.description: Runs when the computer running Companion locks. Companion registers it only on macOS and Windows; Companion on Linux ignores it.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.

oneOf.title: event: computer_unlocked
oneOf.description: Runs when the computer running Companion unlocks. Companion registers it only on macOS and Windows; Companion on Linux ignores it.

enabled.description: Whether the event can start the trigger.
